verdict.rationale: Moss exposes an HTTP API (all actions go through /v1/manage) and publishes an API reference, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair ask. However, the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and human-readable API reference are not an OpenAPI-equivalent spec, and no other evidence shows one exists. Confidence is medium because the probe only checked a handful of candidate paths.
